_about: Inbox messages about a student's grade (GAD-T702): the AI panel's preliminary result and the published grade. Built on the server (Inbox/GradeInbox.cs) in the student's primary language; plain text.
inbox.preliminary.title: Preliminary result: {0}
inbox.preliminary.intro: PRELIMINARY: this is the AI examiner panel's assessment of your exam. It is NOT your final grade. Your final grade comes after a human review of your exam, and you will get another message when it is published.
inbox.preliminary.objectives: Each learning objective, as the AI panel assessed it:
inbox.evidenceNone: None of your answers addressed this objective clearly enough to judge it.
inbox.mock: Test mode: these levels come from the simulated panel, not a real AI evaluation.
inbox.confidence.insufficient: insufficient (no usable answer to judge; level 0 means not enough evidence, not zero understanding)
inbox.confidence.limited: limited (one usable answer, or the AI voters disagreed)
inbox.confidence.moderate: moderate (several answers, judged by one AI voter)
inbox.confidence.corroborated: corroborated (several answers, and independent AI voters agreed)
inbox.final.title: Your grade: {0}
inbox.final.intro: Your grade for {0} has been published.
inbox.final.introAi: Your grade for {0} has been published. It was produced by the AI examiner panel.
inbox.final.overall: Overall: your strongest area was {0}; the area to work on most is {1}.
inbox.final.overallEven: Overall: you showed the same level across every objective ({0}).
inbox.final.more: Open your result for the full report, the evidence and how to appeal.
